公司簡介
Company Profile
康師傅控股有限公司（「本公司」）及其附屬                Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp. (the “Company”), and its
公司（「本集團」）主要在中國從事生產和銷                subsidiaries (the “Group”) specialise in the production and distribution
售 方 便 麵 及 飲 品。 本 集 團 於 1992 年 開 始   of instant noodles and beverages in the People’s Republic of China (the
生 產 方 便 麵， 並 自 1996 年 起 擴 大 業 務 至   “PRC”). The Group started its instant noodle business in 1992, and
方便食品及飲品；2012 年 3 月，本集團進             expanded into instant food business and beverage business in 1996.
一步拓展飲料業務範圍，完成與 PepsiCo              In March 2012, the Group further expanded its beverage business by
中國飲料業務之戰略聯盟，開始獨家負責                  forming a strategic alliance with PepsiCo for the beverage business in
製 造、 灌 裝、 包 裝、 銷 售 及 分 銷 PepsiCo    the PRC. The Company exclusively manufactures, bottles, packages,
於 中 國 的 非 酒 精 飲 料。「康 師 傅 」作 為 中     distributes and sells PepsiCo soft drinks in the PRC. After years of hard
國家喻戶曉的品牌，經過多年的耕耘與積                  work and accumulation, “Master Kong” has become one of the best-
累，深受中國消費者喜愛和支持。                     known brands among consumers in the PRC.

康師傅作為快消品行業的領導品牌，肩負                  Being a leading brand in the fast moving consumer goods industry,
引領行業食品安全與質量保障的使命，本                  Master Kong has to hold the industry responsibility of food safety
集團不斷構建和完善管理體系，建立風險                  and quality guarantee. The Group constantly builds and improves
預防管理機制，實施食品安全的全方位控                  management system, establishes risk prevention management system,
制，確保產品質量與安全，為廣大消費者                  implements entire control over food safety and ensures product quality
提供安全、美味、健康的食品。                      and safety. We will constantly strive for product quality and food safety,
                                    as well as provide consumers with safe, tasty and healthy food products.

本集團不斷完善遍佈全國各地的銷售網                   The Group distributed its products throughout the PRC through
絡， 令 新 產 品 更 加 快 速、 有 效 地 登 陸 市     its extensive sales network consisting of 357 sales offices and 271
場，使得集團產品處於行業領先地位。截                  warehouses serving 67,215 wholesalers and 220,623 direct retailers
至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，本集團共擁有 357       as of 31 December 2024. This extensive sales network is a significant
個營業所及 271 個倉庫以服務 67,215 家經          contributor to the Group’s leading market position and it enables the
銷商及 220,623 家直營零售商。                 Group to introduce new products rapidly and effectively.

本公司於 1996 年 2 月在香港聯合交易所有            The Company was listed on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited
限公司上市。於 2024 年 12 月 31 日，本公         in February 1996. Market capitalisation as at 31 December 2024 was
司之市值達 570 億港幣。現時本公司為摩               HK$57 billion. The Company is a constituent stock of Morgan Stanley
根士丹利資本國際 (MSCI) 中國指數成份股             Capital International (MSCI) China Index and Hang Seng Index.
及恒生指數成份股。

今後，本集團仍將發展焦點集中於食品製                  Focused on food manufacture, sales and distribution business, the
造、行銷及流通行業，並繼續強化通路與                  Group will continue to strengthen its logistics and sales network in the
銷售系統網絡，以建立「全球最大中式方                  PRC with target of becoming “The largest Group for Chinese Instant
便食品及飲品集團」為奮鬥目標。                     Food & Beverage in the World”.

主席報告
Chairman’s Statement
康師傅作為中國食品飲料行業領先的民族                 Master Kong, as a company of the leading national brand in China’s
品牌企業，始終堅守「歡樂飲食，美好生                 food and beverage industry, has consistently upheld the mission of
活」的使命，以消費者需求為導向，創新                 “Life+Delicacy”, taken consumer demand as the orientation, and
奮進，推動企業「高質量發展」。                    been pressing ahead with innovations, thus driving the “high-quality
                                   development” of the company.

回 首 2024 年， 全 球 經 濟 複 雜 多 變， 食 品   In retrospect of the 2024, the global economy was complex and volatile,
飲料行業面臨原材料價格波動、市場競爭                 and the food and beverage industry faced opportunities and challenges
加劇、渠道變革等機遇與挑戰。面對內外                 of fluctuations in raw material prices, intensified market competition
部環境變化，憑藉穩健的策略和團隊的努                 and channel transformations, among others. In the face of changes in
力，集團保持良好發展態勢，業績穩步增                 the internal and external environment, the Group maintained a sound
長。                                 development momentum and delivered resilient growth in performance
                                   by leveraging its prudent strategies and team efforts.

過去的一年，在「長期主義」指引下，集團                Over the past year, guided by long-termism principle, the Group
不斷推動產品升級和結構調整，加大研發                 has been continuously promoting product upgrades and structural
投入，推出一系列健康、美味的產品，滿                 adjustments, increasing investment in research and development,
足消費者的不同場景需求。增強品牌與年                 and launching a series of healthy and delicious products to meet the
輕消費群體的情感連接，精細化渠道經營                 diverse needs of consumers for different occasions. Efforts have been
和市場營銷，提升費用投放效率。加快系                 made to strengthening the emotional bond between our brand and
統平台整合，強化數字化技術運用。守牢                 young consumer groups, refining channel operation and marketing,
食品安全底線，踐行綠色環保發展理念，                 and improving cost efficiency. In the meanwhile, the Group accelerated
全力支持消費者對美好生活的追求。                   integration of system platforms and further strengthened application
                                   of digital technologies. The bottom line of food safety has been
                                   uncompromisingly committed, and the concept of green development
                                   has been practiced to fully support consumers’ pursuit of a better life.

展 望 2025 年， 康 師 傅 堅 定 走「質 」與「量 」   The outlook to 2025 heralds that Master Kong will firmly stay the
全面協調發展的道路。我們將持續加大在                 course of comprehensive and coordinated development, featuring
產品創新、品牌建設、渠道拓展方面的投                 both “quality” and “quantity”. We will keep bolstering our investment
入，穩健經營。以卓越品質和優質服務，                 in product innovation, branding and channel expansion for a robust
把康師傅打造成一個讓政府放心、合作夥                 operation. With excellent quality and premium service, Master Kong
伴開心、消費者安心的綜合性食品飲料民                 will be built into a comprehensive food and beverage “National Brand”
族品牌，為社會發展貢獻更多力量。                   that instills confidence in the government, brings joys to partners, and
                                   reassures consumers, thus making greater contributions to the society.

在此，我謹代表康師傅控股，向一直以來                 Here, on behalf of Tingyi Holding, I would like to extend my sincere
支持我們的股東和董事會、辛勤付出的全                 gratitude to the shareholders and the Board of Directors who have
體同仁、廣大的消費者和合作夥伴表示衷                 consistently supported us, all our dedicated colleagues who have put
心感謝。                               in great efforts, the vast audience of consumers, and our esteemed
                                   business partners.



魏宏名                                Wei Hong-Ming
董事會主席                              Chairman of the Board

中國香港                               Hong Kong, China

宏觀及行業回顧                                          MACRO AND INDUSTRY REVIEW

2024 年， 國 內 經 濟 保 持 穩 健 增 長，GDP                  In 2024, China’s domestic economy maintained steady growth, with
同 比 增 長 5.0%，CPI 小 幅 上 升 0.2%。 消                 GDP growing by 5.0% year-on-year and CPI increasing slightly by
費態度更加謹慎和理性，注重情緒價值、                               0.2%. Consumption sentiment turned more cautious and rational,
健康、綠色環保、品質化及性價比。渠道                               focusing on emotional value, health, green environmental protection,
繼續演化，線下大賣場衰落，倉儲會員店                               quality and cost effectiveness. The channels kept evolving, where offline
保持增長，食雜店、小超市等近場小業態                               hypermarkets were declining, warehouse membership stores kept
仍 有 增 量。 面 對 新 的 消 費 趨 勢 與 渠 道 變                 growing, and proximity-based small-format retail, including grocery
革，企業需精準洞察需求，把握渠道發展                               stores and small supermarkets, still witnessed growth. In the face of
方向，深化消費場景理解，加強與消費者                               new consumption trends and channel changes, enterprises needed
互動，創新產品，以迎接新機遇與挑戰。                               to gain insights to the demands with precision, grasp the direction of
                                                 channel development, deepen understanding of consumption scenarios,
                                                 enhance interactions with consumers, and make innovations on
                                                 products, with a view to embracing new opportunities and challenges.

2025年，全球經濟環境複雜多變，中國經   In 2025, the global economic environment will be complex and
濟增長的核心動力仍來自內需。食品飲料     volatile, and the powerhouse of China’s economic growth still comes
行業預計將保持穩健增長，同時消費者需     from domestic demand. The food and beverage industry is expected
求持續升級，對健康、可持續性和性價比     to maintain steady growth, while consumer demand will continue

本公司的薪酬政策如下：                          The Company’s remuneration policies are as follows:

(a)   包括董事在內的薪酬政策及常規應                (a)    Remuneration policies and practices, including directors, should
      該 公 平 公 正 及 具 有 透 明 度， 符 合 法          be fair and impartial and transparent and comply with regulatory
      規要求；                                  requirements;

(b)   所定董事的薪酬水準應足以吸引及                (b)    The remuneration of directors should be set at a lever sufficient
      挽留董事管好公司營運而又不致支                       to attract and retain them to manage the Company’s operations
      付 過 多 的 酬 金， 並 參 照 公 司 對 其 履          without excessive payment, while taking into account the
      行職責所需時間的要求；及                          Company’s requirements for the time required to perform their
                                            duties; and

(c)   董事不得參與制定其個人薪酬。                 (c)    A director must not be involved in the making of his personal
                                            remuneration.

30. 以權益結算股份支付之交易                                  30. EQUITY SETTLED SHARE-BASED TRANSACTION

     (a)   2008 年購股權計劃                               (a)   2008 Share Option Scheme

           有關批准採納本公司購股權計                                   The Company’s share option scheme (the “2008 Share
           劃（「2008 計劃」）之決議案已在                              Option Scheme”) was adopted pursuant to a resolution
           於 2008 年 3 月 20 日 通 過。 該                        passed on 20 March 2008. The 2008 Share Option Scheme
           2008 計劃之目的乃鼓勵參與者                                is a share incentive scheme and is established to recognise
